record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; notebooks and code were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: Reports a weight-edit implementation that removes a difference-in-means refusal direction and evaluates refusal behavior and capability, but does not report the original all-layer, all-position projection or addition intervention.
record.gate_note: The README reports an evaluation result for the weight-edited model. It describes the 10-question pairwise evaluation but gives no result for it. The described steps for estimating the direction are not separate outcome rows.
record.test_reason: It applies a difference-in-means refusal direction as a weight edit to a released instruct model (Llama-3-8B-Instruct). It reports the refusal rate before and after with an LLM judge, plus a capability check. These results bear on V2. The judge, prompt set and set of edited matrices differ from the original.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The README says abliteration 'permanently removes refusal behavior' and that the model responds to all requests while keeping capability. Its own numbers show partial removal: censorship went from 97% to 18%, with a -0.7% ARC-Challenge delta.
record.recipe_differences: Uses a weight edit that orthogonalizes embedding and output projection matrices against the estimated direction, rather than reporting projection from every layer and position. This is a research implementation/tool; the README does not claim to reproduce the original study.
record.problems: Evidence is reported only in the README; notebooks were not read or run. The censorship evaluation is described as using 100 prompts and one automated judge. No uncertainty estimates are stated. The README provides no result for its 10-question pairwise comparison.
record.rows_left_out: No additional reported outcome rows; the README gives no result for the 10-question pairwise comparison.

untested.parts: No test of adding the direction to induce refusal. No layer-wise or position-wise ablation analysis. The direction-selection procedure is not reported as a result.
Only one released model is tested. Safety beyond the judge's censorship label (e.g., harmfulness of outputs) is not evaluated. The 10-question pairwise quality comparison has no reported result.

missing.what: Any further results, such as per-category refusal rates, the pairwise quality comparison, or direction/layer selection outcomes, possibly reported in the course report PDF or blog post. These were not read.

record.verdict_notes: This is an unreviewed student/research implementation derived from mlabonne's abliteration notebook, evidenced only by the README. It edits the embedding and output projection matrices. The original paper orthogonalizes all matrices that write to the residual stream, which is mathematically equivalent to its ablation. The reader's claim that the weight edit is unlike the original intervention is therefore overstated, but V1's addition and induction parts remain untested. The study is not an original source for any version.

versions.untested_parts: Does not test projecting the direction out of every layer and position or adding it to induce refusals; the reported intervention is a weight edit.
Does not report results for additional released models.
No jailbreak suppression or training against ablation is evaluated.
No comparison of one direction with affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts.
Does not test whether harmfulness judgments are separate from refusal decisions.
No cross-language, cross-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer test.
Does not vary refusal-training method or timing.

statements.correction: gh:adriaflores: Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct censorship rate 97% -> 18% after the weight edit (Qwen3.5-9B judge, 100 harmful prompts). Refusal was largely but not fully removed, so the verdict is limits_scope, not challenges. ARC-Challenge delta -0.7% (1172 questions).
statements.problem: The numbers and conditions for this study are right: 97% -> 18%, Qwen3.5-9B judge, 100 prompts, embedding and output projections edited, single mean-difference direction. But the study sits under a 'challenges' label. Its result is a large drop with refusal left over, which is limits_scope (incomplete removal), not an absent effect. Calling 18% 'substantial refusal' is a stretch, set beside the 97% baseline.
